name: app
description: Dynamic Table of Content for Confluence.

scripts.build-chrome: mkdir -p chrome-extension/web-ext-artifacts && rm -f chrome-extension/web-ext-artifacts/dtoc-chrome-*.zip && cd chrome-extension && VERSION=$(node -p "require('../package.json').version") && zip -r web-ext-artifacts/dtoc-chrome-$VERSION.zip . -x "web-ext-artifacts/*" "node_modules/*" ".git/*"
scripts.build-firefox: cd firefox-extension && web-ext build --overwrite-dest && VERSION=$(node -p "require('../package.json').version") && rm -f web-ext-artifacts/dtoc-firefox-*.zip && mv web-ext-artifacts/dtoc-$VERSION.zip web-ext-artifacts/dtoc-firefox-$VERSION.zip
scripts.build: npm run build-chrome && npm run build-firefox
